item: 1/4 in thick aluminum flat bar, 2 in wide preferred, 48 in or longer
acceptable_substitute: 1/4 in x 1-1/2 in aluminum flat bar if 2 in is unavailable
purpose: Hard spacer pads under NXT rail at roof-bow fastener stations
buy_criteria: Cut into 12-16 short pads, about 3-4 in long; aluminum remains the crush-control spacer
avoid: Thin aluminum, steel/zinc strip, wood, PVC, full-length strip under rail
notes: One 48 in bar makes 12 x 4 in pads or 16 x 3 in pads. Buy a second bar if mistakes or a third rail are likely.

item: Black self-adhesive rubber pad or sheet
acceptable_substitute: Dense solid rubber packing sheet, roof pipe boot rubber, or neoprene/EPDM gasket material
purpose: Thin isolation/gasket layer between aluminum spacer pad and roof skin
buy_criteria: Buy only if dense/solid, hard to compress with thumbnail, about 1/16-1/8 in thick, and labeled outdoor/weatherproof/EPDM/neoprene/rubber
avoid: Foam weatherstrip, furniture pads, felt, soft squishy pads, thick rubber that becomes the spacer
notes: Home Depot in-store location observed: Aisle 10, Bay 018. Stick adhesive side to underside of aluminum pad, not the roof. Bed/seal the pad with real sealant; do not trust pressure-sensitive adhesive.

item: Rubber roof pipe boot/rain collar flashing
purpose: Best Home Depot hack for real roof-rated rubber if sheet EPDM is not stocked
buy_criteria: Buy if the boot is EPDM/neoprene/synthetic rubber and has enough flat area to cut 12-16 gasket pads
avoid: Metal-only flashing, asphalt products, brittle plastic collars
notes: Cut small flat gasket pieces. Use under aluminum pads, not as the spacer.

item: Stainless machine bolts, washers, nylock nuts; 1/4-20 or 5/16-18 TBD
acceptable_substitute: Stainless carriage/hex bolts if head clearance works
buy_criteria: With the temporary 1.75 in assumed stack, buy 2-1/2 in stainless bolts; final diameter still waits on rail channel and bow access
avoid: Zinc-plated hardware for exposed roof, self-drilling sheet-metal screws as primary structure, 2 in bolts for the 1.75 in stack
notes: 2-1/2 in gives room for washer/backing/nylock/thread protrusion. Buy 3 in only if the backing stack gets noticeably thicker.

item: EPDM/neoprene bonded sealing washers sized to bolts
acceptable_substitute: Stainless sealing washer with rubber bonded washer
purpose: Fastener-head leak control under exposed bolt heads
buy_criteria: Match final bolt diameter; rubber washer captured under metal washer
avoid: Loose rubber washer alone as structural spacer
notes: Use with sealant cap/detail after bedding cure.

acceptable_substitute: Compatible silicone roof sealant if 884 unavailable
purpose: Exposed fastener caps, pad edges, roof-system detailing
buy_criteria: Use for exposed caps/edges after mechanical fastening and bedding
avoid: Using Henry 884 as the structural adhesive
notes: Do not bury clamp slots or make full-length dams.

item: Sikaflex-252 or marine polyurethane bedding adhesive
acceptable_substitute: 3M 5200 if permanent removal-hostile bond is acceptable
buy_criteria: Use interrupted pads/beads at bow stations only
avoid: Construction adhesive, asphalt roof cement, foam adhesive, full-length adhesive dam
notes: Home Depot may not stock the right Sika. If unavailable, buy online/elsewhere rather than substituting mystery adhesive.

item: Interior backing washers/plates or crush sleeves
home_depot_search: stainless fender washer aluminum flat bar spacer
acceptable_substitute: Stainless fender washers, aluminum backing strip, or sleeves
purpose: Spread load inside roof bows and prevent crush/oil-canning
buy_criteria: Select after confirming bow width, wall thickness, and access
avoid: No backing, over-tightening into thin skin/bow, rubber-only compression stack
notes: May be fender washers now; backing plates/sleeves later if access allows.

home_depot_search: painter tape isopropyl alcohol scotch brite
acceptable_substitute: Clean rags, Scotch-Brite pads, deburring bit
purpose: Clean bonding surfaces and keep sealant out of rail slots
buy_criteria: Buy if not already in shop
notes: Mask rail slots and roof before bedding pads.
